mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT YEAR(released_at) FROM Drama ORDER BY YEAR(released_at) ASC
SELECT genre_id as genreId, name FROM Genre ORDER BY name ASC

SELECT d.drama_id AS dramaId, title AS title, released_at AS releasedAt, description AS description FROM Drama d JOIN DramaGenre dg on d.drama_id = dg.drama_id WHERE dg.genre_id = #{genreId} ORDER BY dg.genre_id DESC, d.drama_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Drama WHERE title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')

SELECT drama_id AS dramaId, title AS title, released_at AS releasedAt, description AS description FROM DRAMA WHERE title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY released_at DESC, drama_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT drama_id AS dramaId, title AS title, released_at AS releasedAt, description AS description FROM Drama WHERE drama_id = #{dramaId}
